frame: x east, y north, z up, origin at the shared trace vertex

rakes.fixed: fixed rake: slip along the tensor's shear
rakes.free: free rake: slip vector on the Coulomb disc

rake: Aki-Richards: 0 left-lateral, 90 reverse, 180 right-lateral; under the fixed rule set per element by the tensor, under the free rule solved
tensor: most compressive axis horizontal at azimuth theta; r = 0 thrust, r = 1 strike-slip, diag(-1, r, 1 - r) between, unit maximum shear
